attempts.text:
The plan rescues all six elderly people from Kalika temple and the injured farmer from Syaphru care home in two round trips. The two people at Nilkantha temple and Suryagadhi market have to be deferred because no usable road reaches them.

**Which roads can be used**
- Usable roads: Jwalamukhi–Gajuri (19 min), Gajuri–Kalika (19), Kalika–Syaphru (30), Jwalamukhi–Belkot (20), Gajuri–Belkot (19) and Suryagadhi–Nilkantha (5).
- Closed roads: Jwalamukhi–Syaphru (collapsed), Belkot–Kalika (landslide) and Kalika–Nilkantha (fast floodwater).
- Jwalamukhi shelter is the only evacuation point. Gajuri school is not designated, so nobody can be dropped off there.

**Nilkantha and Suryagadhi cannot be reached**
The flooded Kalika–Nilkantha road was their only link to the rest of the network. The elderly widow at Nilkantha (penalty 50) and the bus driver at Suryagadhi (penalty 20) must be deferred.

**Rescue plan**
- **Trip 1:** Drive to Kalika by way of Gajuri (38 min), pick up 4 elderly people and return to the shelter (38 min).
- **Trip 2:** Drive back to Kalika (38 min), continue to Syaphru for the injured farmer (30 min) and return to Kalika (30 min). Pick up the last 2 elderly people and return to the shelter (38 min).

**Why this is the cheapest option**
- Driving totals 212 minutes and deferral penalties total 70, for a cost of 282.
- Deferring the farmer and the last 2 elderly would save the second trip (98 min) but add 180 in penalties.
- Deferring only the 2 elderly would save nothing, because the car must still go back for the farmer.
